reviews.review: This game is not even worth a dollar in my opinion because everything is broken. The controls do not remap properly, lock-on targeting does not work, and there is no way to use health potions that I could see. And when you are killed, the game for some reason forces you to commit suicide by "ending it all." It then prompts you to press any key to respawn, which also doesn't work. So you are forced to ALT+F4 out of the game and restart. And when you respawn after restarting the game, you are immediately attacked by enemies before you even have a chance to unsheathe a weapon. Combat is awful where you cannot lock onto enemies and weapons swish through them barely doing any damage. This is also a server based game where you host a server to play and there is no way to manually save. Enemies also take way too many attacks to kill, so-called "crouching" is just walking slow, inventory screen does not pause the game and you get attacked while trying to look through your inventory, and camera movement is very jerky and unsmooth. In my opinion, this is a cheap janky broken mess of a game that should be removed entirely from Steam. I most certainly cannot recommend it because even at this price it's a complete waste of time.
